cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:14.title: Business Development Manager - Commercial
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:14.description: Position Summary The Commercial Business Development Manager is responsible for driving profitable commercial growth while managing commercial projects from opportunity through closeout. This role owns commercial customer relationships, estimating, proposal follow-up, bid tracking, commercial installation scheduling, project coordination, billing support, closeout documentation, and communication between customers, operations, leadership, and field teams. The value of this role extends beyond generating sales. Success is measured by ensuring the right projects are sold, scheduled, handed off, completed, billed, and closed out in a way that protects gross margin, cash flow, customer relationships, and crew productivity. Key Responsibilities Business Development Develop new commercial customers and strengthen existing key accounts. Build relationships with builders, contractors, property managers, general contractors, and commercial clients. Attend networking, builder, and industry events as needed. Maintain a healthy commercial sales pipeline and communicate risks and opportunities proactively. Estimating, Bids & Proposals Prepare commercial estimates, bids, and proposals. Review project scope, labor requirements, material needs, pricing, and projected margins before submitting proposals. Track open bids and follow up consistently until opportunities are won, lost, or intentionally closed. Maintain accurate bid logs, proposal trackers, and sales forecasts. Scheduling & Project Coordination Manage commercial installation scheduling using the company's scheduling software. Coordinate scheduling with operations leadership, service management, project supervisors, field crews, and customers. Confirm labor, materials, timelines, and customer expectations prior to scheduling work. Communicate scheduling updates and changes promptly. Project Management & Field Support Coordinate project handoffs from sales and estimating to operations and field leadership. Serve as the primary liaison between customers, project supervisors, and internal teams. Help resolve issues involving project scope, materials, scheduling, documentation, and customer expectations. Participate in project walkthroughs, punch lists, and closeout meetings as needed. Billing, Closeout & Documentation Coordinate commercial billing support and project closeout documentation. Gather and organize billing documentation, customer requirements, closeout packages, and safety documentation. Ensure all required project documents are accurate, complete, and submitted on time. Work with Accounting and Operations to reduce billing delays and support timely collections. Gross Margin & Profitability Protect gross margin while pursuing profitable growth. Review project performance and margin concerns with leadership. Identify pricing, labor, material, and scope issues that could impact profitability. Participate in post-project reviews when actual results differ from estimates.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d5e2f414-7a15-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Complaints Specialist based in United States. This is an opportunity to join a customer-focused complaints team within a fast-paced, technology-driven financial services environment. You will investigate complex, escalated, and regulated customer complaints and determine appropriate resolutions. The role combines regulatory expertise, analytical thinking, sound judgment, and strong written communication. Beyond resolving individual cases, you will identify recurring issues, customer harm risks, and opportunities to improve processes. You will collaborate closely with Operations, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Product teams to strengthen controls and customer outcomes. The position offers significant exposure to regulated lending operations and opportunities to influence the broader customer experience. This is a remote role for a detail-oriented professional who is comfortable managing sensitive cases and working independently. Manage a queue of customer complaints and complete accurate investigations and resolutions within established productivity, quality, and regulatory requirements. Investigate sensitive, escalated, and regulated complaints, assessing root causes, potential customer harm, and appropriate remediation. Apply consumer financial regulations and requirements, including FCRA, UDAAP, FDCPA, and ECOA, when evaluating complaints and determining outcomes. Prepare clear, accurate written complaint responses and maintain thorough documentation supporting investigation findings, decisions, and resolutions. Analyze complaint data, recurring issues, and trends to identify root causes and recommend improvements that reduce repeat complaints and customer harm. Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product, and other stakeholders to resolve complex customer issues and strengthen complaint processes and controls. Contribute insights that improve customer experiences and help identify operational or regulatory risks across lending products. Support a culture of accuracy, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer advocacy within the complaints function. Requirements: At least 1 year of experience handling regulatory or escalated customer complaints within a financial institution, lending organization, or another regulated financial services environment, including complaints involving regulators such as the CFPB, BBB, or State Attorneys General. Demonstrated experience conducting complaint investigations, documenting findings, identifying root causes, and determining or recommending appropriate customer resolutions.
